title: Crispy Italian Sausage with Orecchiette
description: A keto-friendly take on a classic Italian dish, featuring crispy sausage and orecchiette pasta.
instructions: Slice the Italian sausage into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sausage and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until crispy.
Transfer the sausage to a baking sheet and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
While the sausage is baking, cook the orecchiette pasta according to package instructions.
Combine the cooked pasta, crispy sausage, and parmesan cheese in a large bowl.
Season with Italian seasoning and serve hot.
